Com backoff maior que zero e auto-pilot: With a backoff above zero and auto-pilot on, a failed task is rescheduled N minutes out instead of going straight back to the queue. 0 = back on the next tick, which in practice pays for two full sessions on the same deterministic failure.

As subtasks partem da branch da task pai: Subtasks branch off the parent task branch and are merged back into it when done; the parent runs last, as integration, and does the push/PR. With this on, a task that runs out of attempts is broken down once instead of becoming blocked.
Depois do comando de verificação, uma se: After the verification command, a cheap read-only session (auxiliary model) checks whether the diff delivers what the task asks. If it rejects, the task goes back to "To do" with the feedback in the error log and counts as an attempt.

Mata a sessão quando ela chama a mesma t: Kills the session when it calls the same tool with the same input 3 times in a row or makes 40 calls without editing a file. Counts as a failed attempt.
Bash roda confinado (filesystem e rede;: Bash runs confined (filesystem and network; only GitHub and package registries allowed), on top of the guardrails. macOS/Linux. If the sandbox is unavailable the session fails instead of running without it. Recommended before turning on auto-merge.
Com a revisão automática ligada, sobe a: With automatic review on, starts the app from the task worktree, takes a screenshot (Playwright — run `npx playwright install chromium` once) and the reviewer checks the visual side.

CI vermelho ou comentário novo na PR dev: Red CI or a new PR comment sends the task back to the queue with the feedback; the session fixes it and pushes to the same branch. After 3 rounds, notifies via webhook (pr_needs_human).
